passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.description: Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals magic damage and Slows by % decaying over second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle. Killing a unit with this restores Mana.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges ( second refresh).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation InitialDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.description: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for seconds and dealing magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.description: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by %. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction. Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
